title: Follow up qa-v1-theory-0e9d194c48ffd6c2b5c2d694
behavioral_concerns: follow up: Manual ultraplan.yml line parser in internal/platform/config silently diverges from standard YAML writers, causing effective config to retain defaults while file appears valid

context_requests.reason: Existing config tests and fixtures would show expected YAML round-trip coverage and whether flow/single-quote/comment cases are currently exercised; needed to bound verification surface without expanding to unrelated packages.

evidence.summary: Manual line parser at internal/platform/config/config.go:197-268 uses bufio.Scanner, TrimSpace, suffix ':' section detection, leadingWhitespace>0 for nested headers, SplitN ':' for values, Trim('"') only, and '- ' list prefix; full-line '#' skip only. Handles five list fields via clearListField but misses YAML flow style, single quotes, inline comments, document marker '---', and empty '[]' forms.

Fallback defaults at config.go:181-195 and field allowlist at 155-158 show Sources initialized to 'default' for all fields then selectively overwritten by loadFile; divergence leaves Sources='default' even when file exists and looks valid. setField switch 290-423 lacks handling for list fields with inline values, returning unknown field error for flow style while single-quote/comment cases slip through as literal values.

Architecture docs and other assigned context paths (docs/architecture.md, internal/app/config_commands.go, internal/sprint/domain.go, internal/tui/model.go, internal/web/handlers.go) contain no YAML parsing logic; config show command at internal/app/config_commands.go:33-40 delegates to loadEffectiveConfig/Redact and cannot compensate for parser divergence.

theories.claim: List and scalar field handling depends on exact indentation and double-quote stripping, causing valid YAML variations (2- vs 4-space indent, zero-indent list header, empty list '[]', single-quoted items) to bypass clearListField/setField and leave list fields at defaults
theories.basis: loadFile 211-244: section header with list requires leadingWhitespace>0 && section!='' and listConfigField(field) to clear list; scalar list items require TrimSpace '- ' prefix and exact listField match; empty list case at 255-258 requires value=='' to trigger clearListField; single quotes are not stripped at 226/250. A compliant writer emitting 'required_health: []' or 4-space indent or "  - 'runtime_available'" will either take unknown-field path or append quoted literal, or fail to clear defaults, leaving Config.Agentwrap.RequiredHealth / Smoke.Environment at Defaults() silently.
theories.verification_surface: internal/platform/config/config.go:211-243 list header handling; 244-258 list item handling and empty-list gate; 553-575 listConfigField/clearListField; 425-538 Validate
theories.confirmation_condition: Workspace file containing valid YAML list forms such as 'agentwrap:\n  required_health: []' or "    - 'runtime_available'" or 'smoke.environment: []' loads without error but Effective.Config lists equal Defaults() and Sources unchanged, while yaml.Unmarshal confirms file is valid.
theories.refutation_condition: All valid YAML list encodings for agentwrap.required_health, agentwrap.required_capabilities, agentwrap.extra_args, agentwrap.env, smoke.environment are correctly cleared/appended and Sources set to 'workspace', matching yaml.Unmarshal result.
theories.inconclusive_condition: Requires execution of Load against varied YAML fixtures; read-only inspection alone shows structural gate but not runtime Sources outcome.
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Propose approved check that writes each list variant to disposable ultraplan.yml in isolated copy, calls Load, and diffs Effective.Config lists vs file intent; inspect Sources map and Validate result; no mutation of workspace, no shell wrappers, timeout and output limits per policy.

theories.outcome_reason: Code gates at 212-217 and 255-258 are demonstrably whitespace/quote-sensitive and inconsistent with YAML spec, strongly suggesting silent default retention, but without executable check the shard cannot observe Effective.Sources at runtime; blocked on execution.

theories.claim: Manual loadFile parser in internal/platform/config/config.go silently retains defaults when ultraplan.yml is produced by a standard YAML encoder (flow style, inline lists/maps, single quotes, trailing comments, document header) while file remains valid YAML
theories.basis: Inspection of loadFile 197-268 shows ad-hoc line logic: TrimSpace then suffix ':' for section detection, leadingWhitespace>0 gate for nested list headers, SplitN ':' for key/value, Trim('"') only, '- ' prefix for list items, full-line '#' skip only. Standard YAML permits 'runtime: {default: opencode}', 'smoke.environment: [PATH, HOME]', single-quoted scalars, 'default: opencode # comment', '---' header, and 'environment: []' which this parser either errors as unknown field/unsupported line or stores with syntactic noise without applying effective config; error paths return error but comment/single-quote/trailing-space cases retain defaults silently with Sources staying 'default'.
theories.confirmation_condition: A workspace ultraplan.yml that is valid per YAML 1.2 and round-trips via standard yaml.Marshal produces Effective.Config equal to Defaults() and Sources[field]='default' after Load, despite file visually containing non-default values (e.g., inline list, single-quoted scalar, comment-suffixed value, flow mapping).
theories.refutation_condition: Any standard-YAML-written ultraplan.yml containing those constructs is either rejected with explicit parse error or correctly applied so Effective.Config matches file content and Sources[field]='workspace' for all fields.
theories.inconclusive_condition: No execution allowed to materialize a standard-encoder file and call Load; static inspection alone cannot prove runtime Sources retention vs error path without approved check execution.
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read-only static comparison plus future approved check: generate candidate ultraplan.yml bytes via standard yaml.Marshal in disposable 0700 copy; call config.Load with WorkspaceRoot pointing at copy and no env/CLI overrides; record Effective.Config and Sources map without writing back; no shell/Git, no file mutation outside copy.
